name: Aethyr ~Tenshi no Ryouiki~
source:
Ninomura Shinobu is a medical student who moves to "Rosellen Court" lodging with a lot of pretty girls around. He can't do anything with the ever-present administrator around, but there's a chance now as administrator goes to a trip. But Shinobu also suffers from nightmares that come every night...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-september-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
二野村忍是一名医学生，他搬到了“Rosellen Court”宿舍，周围有很多漂亮女孩。有管理员在身边他就无能为力，但现在管理员出差了，他有机会了。但忍也每天晚上都会做噩梦……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-september-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
